response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.record_count) AS average_count_above_average, AVG(tc.record_count - overall.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tc.record_count > overall.average_count
